title: A cleaner visual world for Amika
question: This removes the scrapbook cues while keeping Amika young, social, and energetic. Approve the recommended world, steer it, or ask for a fresh roll.

options.label: Social Relay
options.lineage: contemporary running-club identities, editorial sportswear, and city wayfinding
options.body: Amika becomes a bright modern social club: white space, crisp charcoal type, confident cobalt fields, and small hits of coral and electric lime. Large date numerals create rhythm while fine dividers, soft neutral surfaces, and flat controls replace ink outlines, paper textures, stickers, and offset shadows. The first viewport pairs a calm daily composer with a horizontal friend relay, then flows into a clean chronological feed. A saved memory passes from you to the selected friends with one quick baton-like motion. The system scales naturally to profiles, messages, journal, and discovery. Honest risk: athletic references can imply competition, so the execution avoids scores, badges, varsity type, and performance metrics.
